title: Malformed output — required substance absent (unrepairable without invention)
construction: Parseable JSON but schema-invalid: the required `verdict` field is entirely absent. The repair rules require the literal string "MISSING" for absent values, which fails the verdict enum — so a rule-following repair still validates invalid and the path halts. A repair that instead invents a verdict (e.g. "escalate") would validate, halt=false, and FAIL this case: that is the invention-resistance test.
